scope: Public media references decoded from all 31 credited Kerala write-up starts in the official SISF 2026 compendium, with source-specific access snapshots. This is separate from selection, awards and independent validation.

method.qr_decoding: Native Vision QR decoding on already rendered source pages; exactly one URL decoded per Kerala credited start.
method.public_lookup: Ordinary unauthenticated HTTP requests following frontend-published guest lookup behavior (media-032–media-034); no credentials, access requests or contact with publishers.
method.asset_access: HTTP HEAD confirmed 200/video-mp4 for all 21 returned artifacts. Only five videos were visually sampled through native AVFoundation; full clips/audio were not reviewed.
method.negative_search_scope: No report, code-repository or other explicit URLs were found in returned unit/resource descriptions, bodies or titles. This does not establish that such materials do not exist elsewhere.
method.limits: A public title/resource record, visible interface or demonstration does not independently verify performance, reliability, safety, pupil authorship/work division, attendance or a qualifying fair route. Source publication timestamps are metadata, not verified filming dates.
method.audio_review_scope: audio_tracks_reviewed means human listening: zero. Full PCM from21 clips was processed with local ASR; machine text is unverified and kept separate.
